Name: Lavender Craftables
Author: riotgirl5989
Description:
[size=4]About:

[/size]This is a recolor for the craftables into a softer lavender color. It probably looks best with recolors as the brightness of Vanilla Stardew can be quite contrasting against them as you can see in the images.

I do not have shown in the photos but I also have the Hay Hopper, Incubator, and Ostrich Incubator recolored. I have recolored a barn/coop mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21222/]Lavender Coop and Barn[/url]﻿ that I feel works best with the Incubators & Hay Hopper.

Please see config options if you do not like this! 

Thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/140245483]Vin[/url] for letting me use the color palette from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17323]Lavender Dreams[/url]. I highly recommend downloading their mod! 


[size=4]Config:
[/size]All items can be turned on or off in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] so I highly recommend downloading this
The Mini-Obelisk has two options
﻿1. (A fairy lantern)
﻿2. (A standard Mini-Obelisk but in a lavender color)
﻿[spoiler]This includes the 1.6 machines[/spoiler]
